name: Angelic Aberration
oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Flying, vigilance
When this creature enters, sacrifice any number of creatures each with base power or toughness 1 or less. Create that many 4/4 colorless Eldrazi Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, sacrifice any number of creatures each with base power or toughness 1 or less. Create that many 4/4 colorless Eldrazi Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.

needs.what: A token id for "4/4 colorless Eldrazi Angel creature token with flying and vigilance" -- colorless (no colors at all, like the other Devoid-made tokens), creature subtypes Eldrazi and Angel, 4/4, keywords flying and vigilance. One line in the token pool, e.g. `eldrazi_angel_4_4_c_flying_vigilance`.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` is a closed list and holds no colorless Eldrazi Angel. `angel_4_4_w_flying_vigilance` ("4/4 white Angel creature with flying and vigilance") is the near miss and is a different token on two axes: it is WHITE, not colorless, and it is an Angel only, not an Eldrazi Angel. Colour and creature type are both real: this card is Devoid so everything about it is colourless on purpose, the tokens feed Eldrazi-typal and colourless-matters cards, and a white token is hit by protection from white, Angel-typal anthems and colour hosers the printed token is not. The only other colourless Eldrazi token is `eldrazi_spawn_0_1_c` (0/1 with a mana ability), which is unrelated. Substituting either is exactly the "nearly right token" the brief forbids.

needs.what: A selector that reads a creature's BASE power/toughness -- its copiable 4/4-before-effects value (613.2 layer 7a/7b, i.e. printed or set by a copy effect or a type-changing effect), ignoring +1/+1 counters, anthems, Auras, Equipment and pump. Needed as `base_power` / `base_toughness` keys taking the same comparison spec `power`/`toughness` take, so "each with base power or toughness 1 or less" is `{"any_of": [{"base_power": {"op": "<=", "value": {"const": 1}}}, {"base_toughness": {"op": "<=", "value": {"const": 1}}}]}`.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector's `power`/`toughness` keys are the closest thing and read CURRENT characteristics: `src/automtg/engine/effects/selectors.py` (~line 974) does `value = c.power if c else (card.power or 0)`, where `c` is the live characteristics after every continuous effect and counter. On the sandbox board, and on any board with an anthem or a +1/+1 counter, that silently excludes the 1/1s the printed card sacrifices and includes big creatures whose base line is small (an animated 0/1 Plant wearing counters, a 1/1 that got +3/+3). `selector_keys` has no `base_power`, `base_toughness` or printed-characteristics flag; `static_filter_keys` reads printed characteristics but only for static abilities, and this is a triggered ability's effect selector, not a static filter. `x_in_mana_cost` and `mana_cost` are the only printed-only reads available and say nothing about P/T.
